TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS: a) It should have shelves, drawers, or trays made of toughened glass, ensuring durability and chemic al resistance. b) It should have an outer body constructed from galvanized iron, providing corrosion resistance and structural strength. c) It should have an inner body made of mild steel, offering a stable and durable interior suitable for l aboratory use. d) It should have a single-door configuration for compact and efficient access. e) It should have a glass door, allowing visibility of stored items without opening and disturbing the in ternal environment. f) It should have a total storage capacity of 500 liters, with acceptable range between more than 500 liters and up to 600 liters. g) It should support a temperature range from 2°C to 8°C, with precision control. h) It should maintain temperature stability with an accuracy of ±0.5°C, ensuring safe storage of temp erature-sensitive materials.

i) It should allow temperature adjustment in steps of 0.1°C, enabling precise control over storage con ditions. j) It should maintain temperature uniformity within ±0.5°C across the internal chamber. k) It should use a forced air cooling system, ensuring rapid and uniform temperature distribution. l) It should operate with R134a refrigerant, which is CFC-free and environmentally friendly. m) It should be equipped with a microprocessor-based digital temperature controller, providing accura te monitoring and programmable control.
